source: Nokia System Insights MCP (ask + search_specs) on 2026-08-20
session_notes: Queried 3GPP channel estimation, CDL/TDL, DMRS, Rel-18/19 AI/ML air interface.
highlights: Channel estimation uses known DMRS for PDSCH/PUSCH demodulation (Nokia CFAM RP003187 / 5GMax algorithm spec 5G_L1_2794).
TR 38.901 CDL models for MIMO/beamforming; TDL models for demodulation performance (TS 38.101-4 TDLA30/TDLB100/TDLC300).
Rel-18 TR 38.843 studied AI/ML CSI compression, CSI prediction, and beam management; Rel-19 specifies CSI prediction and beam prediction cases.
Evaluation metrics: NMSE of estimated vs true channel, BER after equalization, CSI feedback overhead, throughput.
NTN-TDLA100 (3 taps, 100 ns RMS) and NTN-TDLC5 from TR 38.811 / TS 36.102.

cfam_requirements.summary: Channel estimation of channel coefficients for data-symbol demodulation based on DMRS.
PUSCH receiver channel estimation from DMRS (L1-HI EFS).
